name: edit_file
description:
MUTATION ONLY: replace text in an existing plain-text file, or create one with explicit content. This tool does not read, view, inspect, or list files. To inspect, use read_file(path, start_line?, max_lines?) or read_files; read the relevant text before editing. In restricted mode paths must resolve inside the current registered source scope; allow-all/non-restricted permission modes can use all registered sources, and open mode can also use absolute local paths outside registered sources. Paths may be absolute or relative to a source root. Supports exact string replacement and plain-text file creation.

Use this tool when:
- You need to modify an existing text file (use str_replace with the exact text to find and its replacement)
- You need to create a new text file (use create with the file content)

Do not use Python or run_shell snippets for ordinary plain-text edits. Do not use this tool for DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF files. Use office_artifact for DOCX/XLSX/PPTX candidate-based creation and edits; use run_shell + doc-script-editor for PDF, conversion/rendering, or OOXML compatibility work.

For str_replace: old_str must match exactly once in the file. Include enough surrounding context to make it unique, or pass start_line/end_line to narrow the replacement. Common aliases are accepted: action 'replace' means 'str_replace', old_string means old_str, and new_string/content mean new_str. Always supply new_str (aliases new_string/content); an explicit empty string deletes matched text or creates an empty file, but omitted/null content is rejected. If action is omitted, infer str_replace only with non-empty old_str/old_string and explicit replacement content, or create only with explicit new file content. For new files prefer create_file. Never send read/view actions or read pagination fields to edit_file.

path.description: Path to the file (absolute or relative to a source directory; open mode also accepts absolute local paths outside registered sources)

action.description: Edit action: 'str_replace' to find-and-replace text in an existing file, 'replace' as a convenient alias, or 'create' to create a new file. Optional when the operation is clear from the supplied fields.

old_str.description: For str_replace: exact string to find in the file (must match exactly once)

new_str.description: Required mutation content: replacement text for str_replace, or complete content for create. Explicit empty string is allowed; missing/null is rejected.

content.description: Alias for new_str, especially for create

start_line.description: Optional 1-based inclusive start line limiting where old_str is searched. Useful when old_str appears multiple times.

end_line.description: Optional 1-based inclusive end line limiting where old_str is searched. Useful when old_str appears multiple times.
